$schema_note: Every error an agent can meet, for /docs/reference/errors and explain_error (DOCS-PLAN.md §2, §8 check 3d). `id` is a stable anchor (#<id>); renaming one needs a redirect. `message` is quoted from upstream character for character; `<name>` marks a variable part and `…` is upstream's own elision. null means the sources do not say. `disputed: true` marks a fact the sources disagree on, with both readings.

cli.message: syntax error: parse error: unexpected token "<token>"
cli.cause: The statement does not parse. The error object adds `column` and `source` when the parser reports a position.
cli.remedy: Fix the statement at the reported column; a did-you-mean line follows when the first word is close to a command name.
sources: recorded from the relate CLI built at upstream ac441ec
cli.note: Another recorded form: `syntax error: parse error: expected RightParen, got "RETURN" (RETURN)`.

cli.cause: The statement parses but is rejected before it runs: a missing parameter, an unknown namespace, a write on a read-only open, and similar.
cli.remedy: Read the detail after `semantic error:`; the typed engine errors (ParameterMissing, DatabaseNotFound and others) have their own entries.

cli.cause: An argument value is rejected, for example a DDL `OPTIONS`/`indexConfig` value.
cli.remedy: Correct the rejected value.

cli.cause: A value has the wrong type for the operation.
cli.remedy: Convert or check the value's type in the statement.

cli.cause: A query execution failure discovered while producing rows.
cli.remedy: Read the message; execution failures are not retryable.

cli.cause: Two transactions wrote the same data; the later one lost.
cli.remedy: Re-run the statement in a fresh transaction. This is the only retryable error.

cli.cause: Another process holds the store: a persistent store takes exclusive ownership of its directory and WAL, or its `.rl` file, at open.
cli.remedy: Close the other opener, or open with `--read-only` (a directory store can be read beside its writer; a `.rl` file only while no writer holds it). Not retryable until the other opener exits.
sources: recorded from the relate CLI built at upstream ac441ec
cli.note: The envelope's `message` is `storage locked: <path>`; stderr prints `Failed to open Relate: storage locked: <path>`.

cli.cause: A memory or capacity limit refused the work: the `--logical-graph-size-limit` cap, the per-allocation expression cap, or the 64 MiB per-record WAL payload cap.
cli.remedy: Raise the named limit, or commit the data in smaller transactions.
sources: docs/api/python/spec.md § Error mapping for namespace errors

cli.cause: A storage failure, for example a corrupt snapshot or an unsupported stored value encoding at open.
cli.remedy: Restore from a backup clone; do not copy a snapshot without its WAL.

cli.cause: An operating-system I/O failure, including a full disk.
cli.remedy: Check the path, permissions and free space.

cli.cause: An engine invariant failed; not the statement's fault.
cli.remedy: Report it with `relate --version` and the statement.

cli.cause: A statement ran longer than `--timeout`.
cli.remedy: Bound the work with `LIMIT` or a narrower pattern, or raise `--timeout`.
sources: surfaces/relate-cli/src/help/options.rs and agent_context_cmd.rs at upstream ac441ec (`--timeout` in --help, exit 7 in agent-context)

cli.cause: A parser usage error: unknown flag, bad or missing value, extra positional. stderr carries the `Error:` line, the command's `Usage:` line and a `--help` hint; a close match adds `Did you mean '<flag>'?`.
cli.remedy: Run `relate <command> --help`.

cli.message: Error: the '<command>' command is not included in this build of relate
cli.cause: The command's feature is not compiled into this build bundle (release binaries are the full bundle).
cli.remedy: Use a full build.

cli.cause: A `--param` value that looks like JSON does not parse, is a non-finite number, or is an integer above i64::MAX.
cli.remedy: Quote JSON values; JSON-quote a date that starts with digits.

cli.message: Error: invalid --namespace: unknown namespace '<name>' (expected neo4j, system or system_ontologies)
cli.cause: `--namespace` names something other than the three fixed namespaces.
cli.remedy: Use `neo4j`, `system` or `system_ontologies`.

cli.message: Error: --namespace is not valid with pull (pull always writes the neo4j namespace)
cli.cause: `--namespace` placed before the `pull` verb.
cli.remedy: Drop `--namespace`; pull always writes `neo4j`.

cli.cause: `RELATE_MAX_ROWS` is not a non-negative integer.
cli.remedy: Set an integer; `0` is unlimited.

cli.cause: `RELATE_AGENT_MODE` is not `1` or `0`.
cli.remedy: Set `1` or `0`, or unset it.

cli.cause: `RELATE_DURABILITY_MODE` is not `full`, `everysecond` or `snapshot`.
cli.remedy: Use one of the three values.

cli.message: Error: invalid RELATE_SAFE_MODE: '<v>' is not 1 or 0
cli.cause: `RELATE_SAFE_MODE` is not `1` or `0`.
cli.remedy: Set `1` or `0`, or unset it.

cli.cause: The value does not parse as a size.
cli.remedy: Use bytes or mb/mib/gb/gib; `0` is unlimited.

cli.cause: The value does not parse as a size.
cli.remedy: Use a size, or `none`.

cli.cause: The variable is `0`; a value that does not parse prints `Error: invalid RELATE_CONCURRENT_LOGICAL_WORKSPACE_LIMIT: …` instead.
cli.remedy: Use a positive size, or unset it to leave admission off.

cli.cause: `0`, a value over 2000, or a non-integer.
cli.remedy: Use an integer from 1 to 2000.

cli.message: Error: …: invalid RELATE_PREVIEW value: unknown preview feature '<name>' (known features: …)
cli.cause: `RELATE_PREVIEW` names a feature the engine does not know; the open fails closed.
cli.remedy: Use a name from the known-features list in the message.

cli.cause: The checkpoint every persistent run takes on exit failed, for example on a full disk. A non-zero statement exit code is kept instead.
cli.remedy: Free disk space and check permissions; read-only runs also rewrite the snapshot on exit.

cli.message: Warning: exiting with an open transaction; rolling back uncommitted changes. Use .commit before exiting to persist them.
cli.cause: A `.begin` transaction was still open at exit. One-shot and piped runs exit 1; the interactive shell keeps exit 0.
cli.remedy: End the script with `.commit` (or `.rollback`).

cli.message: Error: could not read query input from stdin: <reason>
cli.cause: Piped stdin could not be read, including invalid UTF-8; nothing runs.
cli.remedy: Pipe valid UTF-8.

cli.cause: A `LOAD CSV` path escapes the configured root, is a symlink escape or a special file, or local files are denied (no `--load-csv-dir`).
cli.remedy: Pass `--load-csv-dir <dir>` and keep files under it.

cli.message: LOAD CSV file exceeds byte limit
cli.cause: The CSV file is over 8,388,608 bytes.
cli.remedy: Split the file; the limit cannot be raised from the CLI.

cli.message: parquet snapshot codec is not compiled into this build (enable the "parquet" feature)
cli.cause: `--snapshot-format parquet` in a build without the parquet feature.
cli.remedy: Use `--snapshot-format json`, or a full build.

cli.message: Error: skill: refusing to touch <dest>: no .relate-installed marker present (directory was not created by relate); pass --force to override
cli.cause: The skills destination exists and was not written by relate.
cli.remedy: Move the directory, or pass `--force` to overwrite it.

cli.cause: `--agent` names an agent the CLI does not know; a second line lists the valid agents.
cli.remedy: Use a name from the `valid agents:` line.

cli.message: warning: result truncated to 100 rows (the statement returned 250); pass --max-rows 0 for all rows
cli.cause: Not an error. The row cap cut the printed rows (100 by default under a detected agent harness with stdout not a terminal). The counts in the message vary.
cli.remedy: Pass `--max-rows 0` for all rows, or bound the work with `LIMIT`.

cli.message: note: write statement changed nothing; the graph is unchanged
cli.cause: Not an error. A write statement applied nothing, often because a zero-row `MATCH` short-circuited it. A transaction that persisted nothing prints `note: .commit changed nothing …`.
cli.remedy: Grep stderr for the prefix `note: write statement`; the exit code stays 0.

engine.cause: The statement references a parameter that was not supplied; it is never bound as null.
engine.remedy: Bind every referenced parameter (`--param N=V`, or the params map of the client).

engine.message: semantic error: DatabaseNotFound: Graph not found: <name>
engine.cause: A session namespace or a `USE` target is not one of `neo4j`, `system`, `system_ontologies`.
engine.remedy: Use one of the three fixed namespaces.
engine.note: Bolt sends the live Community Edition wire status 42001 with a 42N00 cause.

engine.message: syntax error: UndefinedVariable: variable '<name>' not defined
engine.cause: A variable has no binding in scope; an unbound variable never evaluates to null.
engine.remedy: Bind the variable in an earlier clause or carry it through `WITH`.

engine.cause: Integer division by zero. Modulo by zero renders `% by zero`.
engine.remedy: Guard the divisor.

engine.cause: `round(x, p, 'UNNECESSARY')` on a value that needs rounding.
engine.remedy: Use another rounding mode.

engine.cause: The statement was stopped through its cancel token, for example when the Bolt `--query-timeout-secs` bound expired.
engine.remedy: Bound the work, or raise the timeout.

engine.message: This statement tried to commit a single WAL record of at least <used>. This is a safety limit protecting against memory exhaustion — the per-record WAL payload cap is <limit>; commit the data in smaller transactions.
engine.cause: A single commit record is over the 64 MiB per-record WAL payload cap; nothing is written.
engine.remedy: Commit the data in smaller transactions.

engine.cause: A growing write crossed `--logical-graph-size-limit`.
engine.remedy: Raise the limit or reduce the graph.

engine.message: This database is not queryable. Use the db.ontology.* procedures on the user database 'neo4j' instead.
engine.cause: A statement other than an administration command was routed to `system_ontologies`, reads included.
engine.remedy: Run `CALL db.ontology.get()` on `neo4j` with `RELATE_PREVIEW=ontology` set.

engine.cause: A write against the read-only `system_ontologies` namespace.
engine.remedy: Write on `neo4j`; the ontology is set through `db.ontology.*`.

engine.cause: A database administration command beyond `SHOW DATABASE[S]`, `SHOW DEFAULT/HOME DATABASE` and `ALTER DATABASE … SET DEFAULT LANGUAGE CYPHER 5|25`.
engine.remedy: A store has three fixed namespaces; there is nothing to create, drop or alias.

engine.message: The `USE` clause is not required for administration commands. Retry your query without the `USE` clause, and it will be routed automatically.
engine.cause: An explicit `USE` targeting a non-system namespace on an administration command.
engine.remedy: Drop the `USE` clause.

engine.message: The following clauses are not allowed on a system database: WITH.
engine.cause: A `WITH` composing an administration command routed to `system`.
engine.remedy: Run the administration command without composing it.

engine.cause: `graph.byName`, `graph.names` or `graph.propertiesByName`, which are composite-only.
engine.remedy: A statement runs against one graph; query each store separately.

engine.cause: Several distinct `USE` targets in one statement (across `UNION` arms, `CALL` subqueries or `NEXT`).
engine.remedy: Use one target per statement.

engine.cause: The function name is unknown, or it is a preview function whose gate is off.
engine.remedy: Check the name with `SHOW FUNCTIONS`; preview functions need `RELATE_PREVIEW`.

engine.message: preview feature '<name>' is not enabled: set RELATE_PREVIEW=<name>
engine.cause: A gated preview feature was used while disabled. For ontology the full text is `semantic error: SemanticError: preview feature 'ontology' is not enabled: set RELATE_PREVIEW=ontology`.
engine.remedy: Set `RELATE_PREVIEW=<name>` in the environment of the process that opens the store.

engine.message: syntax error: SafeModeViolation: This statement is not allowed in safe mode: an unbounded read (`MATCH … RETURN` or `MATCH … WITH` without `LIMIT`). Safe mode refuses shapes an agent commonly gets wrong — add `LIMIT <n>`, or return an aggregate such as `count(*)`, so the read has a bounded result. This is a policy, not a database limit; reopen without --safe to allow it.
engine.cause: Safe mode (`--safe`) refused a new named node without a label, or a `MATCH` read whose final `RETURN`/`WITH` has no `LIMIT` and no reducing aggregate (`collect()` does not count).
engine.remedy: Add the label, or add a `LIMIT`.
engine.name: SafeModeViolation
sources: recorded from the relate CLI built at upstream ac441ec
engine.note: The message above is the unbounded-read refusal; an unlabeled new node gets its own message.

engine.cause: An explicit `*1..N` or `{1,N}` bound is above `--max-traversal-depth` (default 500).
engine.remedy: Lower the bound, or raise `--max-traversal-depth` (at most 2000).
engine.name: TraversalDepthExceeded

engine.message: NestedEvaluationBudgetExceeded: nested evaluation exceeds 100000 passes per statement; nested subqueries compound per level (security budget).
engine.cause: Nested subqueries, conditional branches and `FOREACH` lists would exceed 100,000 evaluation passes in one statement.
engine.remedy: Flatten the nesting or split the statement.

engine.message: semantic error: WriteOnReadOnlyAccessDatabase: No write operations are allowed on this database. The database is in read-only mode on this Neo4j instance.
engine.cause: A write on a store opened `--read-only` (or an ephemeral `--load` into `:memory:`).
engine.remedy: Reopen without `--read-only` when the write is intended.
engine.name: WriteOnReadOnlyAccessDatabase
engine.note: The Bolt server's message is `database is read-only`.
sources: docs/api/cli/spec.md § Loading a store from a source
recorded from the relate CLI built at upstream ac441ec

engine.cause: A write violates a uniqueness constraint.
engine.remedy: Use `MERGE` on the constrained key, or fix the duplicate.

engine.message: Cannot change the namespace while a transaction is open.
engine.cause: `Connection.set_namespace` with a transaction open.
engine.remedy: Commit or roll back first.

http.remedy: Send `Authorization: Basic` with the `serve` credential (the generated token is printed at startup).

http.cause: A managed transaction sat idle past `--tx-idle-timeout-secs`.
http.remedy: Begin a new transaction; raise the idle timeout if needed.
http.note: Message pattern from the recorded example `transaction tx-7 expired after 60s idle`.

http.message: transaction registry full: 128 open transactions (close one or raise --max-open-transactions)
http.cause: A begin over the `--max-open-transactions` cap. The count in the message is the configured cap.
http.remedy: Close an open transaction or raise the cap.

http.cause: Malformed request body, or a Cypher syntax error.
http.remedy: Fix the body or the statement.

http.cause: Any other caller-facing engine error, undecodable `parameters`, or (with 405) a wrong method; with 500, an IO, storage or locked failure, genericized.
Engine-internal error; the message is genericized.
http.remedy: Report it with the server version.

bolt.message: The client is unauthorized due to authentication failure.
bolt.cause: A failed or missing auth token; the connection closes.
A malformed message: a RUN without a string statement, a bad PULL/DISCARD `n` or `qid`, an unconvertible parameter, a HELLO without `user_agent`, or a protocol breach.

bolt.message: query result exceeds max-result-bytes limit of <N> bytes

mcp.message: Only MATCH queries are allowed for read-query
mcp.cause: `read_cypher` received a write (`w`/`rw`) or schema DDL (`s`) statement. Any pure read passes, `OPTIONAL MATCH` included.
mcp.remedy: Use `write_cypher` for writes, where the server lists it.

mcp.message: Only write queries are allowed for write-query
mcp.note: `write_cypher` is absent when the store is opened `--read-only`.

mcp.cause: An internal-class engine failure (engine-internal, IO, storage, locked); detail is genericized so it never reaches tool-call logs.
A body that is not JSON, omits `jsonrpc` or `method`, or carries an unknown member.

hierarchy.meaning: Base of every relate database error.
Fallback for an unmapped engine error.
Bad type or value; every capacity refusal (kind MemoryLimitExceeded); an out-of-range int parameter.
Open, I/O, transaction; namespace errors; writes on a read-only database.
Constraint violations and deleting a still-connected node without DETACH.
An engine invariant the caller cannot fix.
Syntax errors, missing parameters, parameter-shape mistakes, closed connections, wrong-thread use.
`cursor.single()` got zero rows or more than one.
